name: Tattletale
description: Born from a destroyed surveillance AI. Broadcasts personal data from nearby augments — names, wallet balances, health metrics — to public display systems. A privacy nightmare.
observed_behavior: Intercepts augment telemetry data and routes it to the nearest public display. The data appears for 2-5 seconds before the display returns to normal.
story_hooks: Tattletale broadcasts a corporate executive's medical data on a public screen — including evidence of an illegal augmentation
